import asyncio
import time

async def measure(use_thread):
    stop = asyncio.Event()
    ticks = 0

    async def heartbeat():
        nonlocal ticks
        while not stop.is_set():
            await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
            ticks += 1

    hb = asyncio.create_task(heartbeat())
    await asyncio.sleep(0)          # let the heartbeat start
    if use_thread:
        await asyncio.to_thread(time.sleep, 0.1)
    else:
        time.sleep(0.1)             # blocks the loop on purpose
    stop.set()
    await hb
    return ticks

print(asyncio.run(measure(False)) <= 1, asyncio.run(measure(True)) >= 5)
